rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an appealing or special food, including a cultural delicacy.

example.english: This cha chaan teng’s pineapple buns are truly a Hong Kong delicacy.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記嘅菠蘿包真係香港美食。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 ge3 bo1 lo4 baau1 zan1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 mei5 sik6

rows.note: Use this when “delicacy” means tact, propriety, or knowing how far to go in a situation.

example.english: You need some delicacy even when joking, or people will feel uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 講笑都要有分寸，唔係人哋會唔舒服。
example.jyutping: gong2 siu3 dou1 jiu3 jau5 fan1 cyun3 m4 hai6 jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 syu1 fuk6
